headword: {東海道五十三次|とうかいどうごじゅうさんつぎ}
reading: とうかいどうごじゅうさんつぎ
gloss: the Fifty-three Stations of the Tōkaidō

definitions.gloss: the 53 post stations of the Tōkaidō road; Hiroshige's print series of them
definitions.explanation: The fifty-three post towns on the Tōkaidō highway between Edo (Nihonbashi) and Kyoto in the Edo period, and, above all, Utagawa Hiroshige's famous series of woodblock prints of them, published in the 1830s.

notes:
The count is fifty-three stations, plus the start at Nihonbashi and the end at Kyoto's Sanjō Bridge, which gives Hiroshige's series its 55 prints. The name is also used for sugoroku board games and for walking routes that follow the old road.
